Clean glass, corners, and pipes and arrange gravel with one kit. The handle extends to reach deeper areas, and you can switch between six heads to suit the task.

Includes a net, scraper, flat sponge, corner sponge, pipe brush, and gravel rake. The handle is approximately 60 to 90 cm long depending on extension, helping you reach deeper areas and change heads for each task. Keep the blade away from silicone and sand while cleaning.

Hygger — Model: HGY0001-M.

benefits: Remove algae from glass and reach corners with a flat sponge and a corner sponge.
The extendable handle reduces the need to put your hand in the water.
The pipe brush helps remove dirt from wide pipes and equipment openings.
A net for lifting debris and a rake for arranging gravel complete daily maintenance tasks.
usageInstructions: Fit the appropriate head, adjust the handle length, and tighten the connection.

data.name: Hygger HG124 Floating Magnetic Glass Cleaner with Two Blades
data.description:
Clean algae from the inside of aquarium glass while keeping your hand outside. Two plastic blades help remove deposits, and the inner piece floats if it separates so you can retrieve it easily.

Choose from three sizes according to glass thickness: S for up to 6 mm, M for 6 to 13 mm, and L for 13 to 20 mm. Before every use, check the cleaning surface for grains of sand that could scratch the glass.

benefits: Clean the inside of the aquarium by moving the handle from outside.

data.name: Hygger HG153 Internal Filter with Aeration and Adjustable Flow
data.description:

data.name: Hygger HG101 Multi-Stage External Filter with UV for Green Water
data.description:
Provides multi-stage filtration outside the aquarium, with sponge, activated carbon, and ceramic rings. The enclosed UV unit helps reduce the suspended algae that cause green water, and water is drawn into the filter at the press of a button after the connections are installed.

Choose a rated pump flow of 1200 or 1800 L/h. Each option has three media baskets and a UV lamp with a corresponding power rating. Keep the filter body outside the aquarium and below water level; actual flow is affected by the media, tank height, and tubing length. The UV benefit applies to the suspended algae that cause green water.

Hygger — Models: HG101-1200(UV)-UK, HG101-1800L(UV)-UK.

benefits: Collects suspended debris and provides space for filter media in three removable baskets.
Sponge traps debris, activated carbon helps adsorb some dissolved substances, and ceramic provides a surface for beneficial bacteria.
UV helps reduce suspended algae in the water, with a separate on/off button.

Do not raise the filter above aquarium water level or run it with an exposed intake or loose connections.

data.name: Hygger HG239 5-in-1 Digital Water Meter
data.description:
Monitor aquarium water pH, dissolved salts, conductivity, and temperature with one device. A digital display and reading-hold button help you compare results easily between tests.

Useful for comparing source water with aquarium water and tracking changes, with a HOLD button to freeze the reading and three-point pH calibration. The stated salinity range reaches 9999 ppm, so it is not suitable for measuring typical marine aquarium salinity. Ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, and hardness require their own dedicated tests.

Hygger — Model: HG239-UK.

benefits: Combines pH, TDS, EC, salinity, and temperature measurements so you can track aquarium water changes in one place.
Freeze the result with HOLD and read it after removing the probe from the water sample.
Select the measurement with MODE, with a temperature display and switching between Celsius and Fahrenheit.
Supports three-point pH calibration and automatic temperature compensation within the specified operating range.
usageInstructions: Before measurement or calibration, soak the probe tip in water for two minutes as directed by the manual.
Take a water sample in a clean cup, turn on the meter, and select the required test with MODE.
Lower only the probe tip to the marked immersion line, move it gently, and wait for the reading to stabilize.
Press HOLD to freeze the result. Change the temperature unit by holding HOLD/TEMP for 3 seconds.
After testing, rinse the probe with distilled water and replace the protective cap. Keep the buttons and power compartment dry.
Prepare each pH calibration sachet in a separate container with 250 ml of pure water and dissolve it completely. Do not mix the sachets together.
Rinse the probe between solutions and select pH mode. Put the probe in the required solution and hold CAL for about 3 seconds; wait for the value to flash three times to confirm calibration.
The included calibration values are 4.00, 6.86, and 9.18. Follow the manual for your version when ordering the steps.
Recalibrate after prolonged storage, heavy use, or probe replacement. Calibration solutions are for testing outside the aquarium and must not be added to its water.
safetyWarnings: Immerse only the probe tip; do not pass the marked line or submerge the meter body.
The stated salinity range reaches 9999 ppm; choose a higher-range meter if your sample salinity exceeds this limit.
This meter does not measure ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, GH, or KH; dedicated tests are needed for these parameters.
Protect the probe from impacts and prolonged drying, and do not rely on an unstable reading before cleaning and calibration.

data.name: Magnetic Aquarium Wavemaker — 6 W
data.description:
Moves water inside the aquarium and helps reduce stagnant areas, with an adjustable head and a magnetic base that attaches to the glass. This is the 6-watt version without an inline switch or controller; it runs when connected to power.

Its power is 6 watts, and it attaches to glass up to 10 mm thick. Change the head direction and position to distribute movement according to your aquarium layout. It runs continuously when connected to power, so choose a position that does not displace sand or direct a current stronger than the fish need.

Hygger — model: HG130-6W-NON-SWITCH-UK.

benefits: Helps distribute water movement into aquarium corners that receive insufficient flow.
The head can be aimed to suit the rocks, plants and filter position.
When directed appropriately, it helps move suspended debris towards the filter intake and agitates the water surface.
A magnetic base makes it easier to attach and reposition on glass up to 10 mm thick.
A ceramic shaft is suitable for freshwater and saltwater according to the manufacturer.
usageInstructions: Check that aquarium glass is no thicker than 10 mm and the mounting area is clean.
Hold the pump inside the aquarium and slide the outer magnet along the glass until it meets the base without striking it.
Fully submerge the pump and aim the head away from fine sand or animals that cannot tolerate direct current.
Connect power and monitor water movement and the fish. Disconnect power before changing the direction or position.
Disconnect power before removing it or cleaning the propeller and cover, and clean the intake openings regularly.
safetyWarnings: Do not run it out of water or put your finger near the propeller during operation.
The magnet is strong; bring the pieces together along the glass to protect fingers and glass from pinching or impact.
Protect the intake with suitable sponge if the aquarium contains young fish, shrimp or anemones, and clean it so it does not restrict flow.
Disconnect power before putting your hand in the water, and keep the plug dry with a drip loop in the cable.
Monitor whether the current suits the inhabitants; pump power alone does not determine suitability for every aquarium.

data.name: 8-in-1 Aquarium Water Test Strips — 50 Strips
data.description:
A quick test combines eight aquarium-water indicators on one strip. Dip it for two seconds and compare its colours with the bottle chart after approximately 30 seconds to monitor changes in your care routine.

The indicators are pH, GH, ammonia nitrogen, nitrate, nitrite, total chlorine, KH and total alkalinity. The bottle contains 50 single-use strips. The colour result is approximate: compare it with the chart on the same bottle within the specified time, and confirm unexpected readings with a dedicated test.

Hygger — model: HG006-50.

benefits: Gives a quick overview of eight indicators from one water sample.
No electrical device or mixing drops is needed; the test uses colour comparison with the bottle chart.
A bottle of 50 strips allows repeated tests and monitoring of changes over time.
Suitable for routine freshwater and saltwater aquarium testing according to the manufacturer, using appropriate limits for your aquarium type.
usageInstructions: Take a water sample in a clean cup. Remove one strip with dry hands without touching the test pads, and close the bottle immediately.
Immerse the test pads in the sample for two seconds, then remove the strip.
Keep the strip horizontal and gently remove excess water so liquids from the pads do not mix.
Compare colours with the chart on the same bottle in clear light at the specified time, approximately 30 seconds.
Discard the strip after use and record the result for comparison with the next test.
safetyWarnings: The colour reading is approximate; confirm an unexpected result with a dedicated test before making a major aquarium decision.
Do not read delayed colour changes after two minutes or rely on the colour at the pad edges.
Keep the bottle closed in a dry place away from sunlight and humidity, leaving the desiccant packet inside.
Use the strips before the expiry date printed on your bottle.
The manufacturer describes the ammonia indicator as ammonia nitrogen; do not treat it as a separate measurement of free ammonia, NH3.

data.name: Black Aquarium Background That Attaches to Glass Without Glue
data.description:
Hides the view and cables behind the aquarium and makes fish and plant colours stand out visually. An opaque black background attaches from the outside without glue and can be trimmed to match the glass.

Made from matte black PVC, it uses static cling on the outside of the glass. There are four sizes, and excess material can be trimmed to fit. Measure the back panel height and length before choosing, and protect aquarium water from the application solution during installation.

Remove the clear protective film and spray the glass and application side, then attach the background from the outside.
Push water and bubbles out with the scraper from the centre towards the edges, then trim the excess.
safetyWarnings: Install on the outside of the aquarium only; do not let soapy water or detergent enter the tank.
Bubbles usually need re-wetting and smoothing; do not add your own glue.
